papers.title: Effect of laser focus shift on surface quality and density of Inconel 718 parts produced via selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: The Aerospace Corporation, 2310 E El Segundo Blvd, El Segundo, CA, 90245, United States

corresponding_authors.name: Glenn E. Bean
corresponding_authors.affiliation: The Aerospace Corporation, 2310 E El Segundo Blvd, El Segundo, CA, 90245, United States

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是Inconel 718合金的激光选区熔化工艺参数，与生物医用材料方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies laser focus shift effects on Inconel 718, a non-biomedical alloy, with no discussion of porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光焦点偏移对选区激光熔化Inconel 718部件表面质量和致密度的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验改变激光焦点位置，测量样品的表面粗糙度和密度。
summary_zh.result: 发现焦点偏移显著影响表面质量和致密度，适当偏移可优化性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量和对比验证焦点偏移的影响。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of laser focus shift on the surface quality and density of Inconel 718 parts fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Experimental variation of laser focus position followed by measurement of surface roughness and density of as-built samples.
summary_en.result: Laser focus shift significantly influences both surface quality and density, with an optimal offset improving overall part performance.
summary_en.validation: Validation through direct experimental measurement and comparison of surface roughness and density data.

corresponding_authors.name: Tiechui Yuan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Powder Metallurgy, Central South University, Changsha 410083, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Ruidi Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Powder Metallurgy, Central South University, Changsha 410083, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了通过选区激光熔化制造的生物医用Ti-13Nb-13Zr合金的各向异性力学行为，与用户的增材制造生物医学材料方向相关，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding quantification, no fatigue data, no osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化制造的生物医用Ti-13Nb-13Zr合金各向异性力学行为。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化制备试样并进行拉伸和压缩力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 发现合金具有显著的各向异性，但力学性能与锻造合金相当。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验力学测试验证各向异性行为。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to investigate the anisotropic mechanical behavior of the biomedical Ti-13Nb-13Zr alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were prepared by selective laser melting and subjected to tensile and compression mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Significant anisotropy was observed, but the mechanical properties were comparable to those of the wrought alloy.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through experimental mechanical testing including tensile and compression tests.

llm.relevance_to_user: 涉及选择性激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V的表面改性，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与医用植入物直接相关性有限。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration; focuses on surface modification of dense SLM Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 改进选择性激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V的表面性能以用于生物医学。
summary_zh.method: 对SLM试样进行表面处理并表征其微观结构和摩擦力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 表面改性显著提高了耐磨性和微观结构均匀性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、XRD、硬度测试和摩擦实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the surface properties of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V for potential biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Surface treatments were applied to SLM-fabricated Ti-6Al-4V samples, followed by microstructural and tribo-mechanical characterization.
summary_en.result: Surface modification improved wear resistance and microstructural homogeneity.
summary_en.validation: Validation via SEM, XRD, hardness testing, and tribological experiments.

papers.title: In vitro and in vivo biological performance of porous Ti alloys prepared by powder metallurgy
papers.abstract: Titanium (Ti) and Ti-6 Aluminium-4 Vanadium alloys are the most common materials in implants composition but β type alloys are promising biomaterials because they present better mechanical properties. Besides the composition of biomaterial, many factors influence the performance of the biomaterial. For example, porous surface may modify the functional cellular response and accelerate osseointegration. This paper presents in vitro and in vivo evaluations of powder metallurgy-processed porous samples composed by different titanium alloys and pure Ti, aiming to show their potential for biomedical applications. The porous surfaces samples were produced with different designs to in vitro and in vivo tests. Samples were characterized with scanning electron microscopy (SEM), energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) and elastic modulus analyses. Osteogenic cells from newborn rat calvaria were plated on discs of different materials: G1-commercially pure Ti group (CpTi); G2-Ti-6Al-4V alloy; G3-Ti-13 Niobium-13 Zirconium alloy; G4-Ti-35 Niobium alloy; G5-Ti-35 Niobium-7 Zirconium-5 Tantalum alloy. Cell adhesion and viability, total protein content, alkaline phosphatase activity, mineralization nodules and gene expression (alkaline phosphatase, Runx-2, osteocalcin and osteopontin) were assessed. After 2 and 4 weeks of implantation in rabbit tibia, bone ingrowth was analyzed using micro-computed tomography (μCT). EDS analysis confirmed the material production of each group. Metallographic and SEM analysis revealed interconnected pores, with mean pore size of 99,5μm and mean porosity of 42%, without significant difference among the groups (p>0.05). The elastic modulus values did not exhibit difference among the groups (p>0.05). Experimental alloys demonstrated better results than CpTi and Ti-6Al-4V, in gene expression and cytokines analysis, especially in early experimental periods. In conclusion, our data suggests that the experimental alloys can be used for biomedical application since they contributed to excellent cellular behavior and osseointegration besides presenting lower elastic modulus.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文采用粉末冶金制备多孔钛合金，评估生物学性能，但未采用增材制造（激光粉末床熔融）工艺，且未涉及疲劳或应力屏蔽分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper uses powder metallurgy, not LPBF additive manufacturing, and does not include fatigue testing or explicit stress shielding analysis relative to implant stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 多孔钛合金需要评估其生物学性能以用于植入物。
summary_zh.method: 采用粉末冶金制备不同钛合金多孔样品，进行体外细胞实验和兔胫骨植入。
summary_zh.result: 实验β型钛合金在早期细胞反应和骨整合方面优于纯钛和Ti-6Al-4V。
summary_zh.validation: 体外成骨细胞分析和体内micro-CT骨长入分析。

summary_en.motivation: Porous titanium alloys are promising for biomedical implants but require evaluation of biological performance.
summary_en.method: Powder metallurgy was used to fabricate porous samples of various Ti alloys, and in vitro cell studies and in vivo rabbit tibia implantation were performed.
summary_en.result: Experimental β-type Ti alloys showed improved gene expression and osseointegration compared to CP-Ti and Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.validation: In vitro osteogenic cell assays and in vivo micro-CT analysis of bone ingrowth at 2 and 4 weeks.
